morgan-2.text: Could a specific approved task explain this action? Compare the target, operation and review period. Approval for one task does not explain a different action.

morgan-3.text: Attach the acquired observation to the claim it actually supports or weakens. A source record and your interpretation are different things.

morgan-4.text: Missing collection limits the conclusion. A successful future test proves only its stated target, capability and time. It cannot recover an unrecorded historical interval.

morgan-5.text: Name the narrow scope, the business consequence, the authorised owner and a concrete follow-up. An investigator recommends a response; they do not approve their own control.

morgan-6.text: Review the observations available when you made the call. Keep later simulation facts separate, and identify the next source that would strengthen a similar investigation elsewhere.

check-ready.text: Your requested business check is ready to review. Its response or timeout establishes only the stated business context and limits.

report-submitted.text: Case report submitted. Your finding is frozen. Review the evidence you had and the separate simulated outcome.

finding-explained.text: The cited observations support this specific approved-work explanation within the scope and period you investigated. That finding does not establish that every other system or session is clear.

finding-misuse.text: The cited observations support activity outside the disclosed approved scope. This is a bounded session finding, not proof of a particular person or motive. Keep the response within the declared authority.

finding-visibility.text: You established a useful visibility limit. Missing collection does not establish whether activity was benign or malicious. Assign restoration, a repeat check and a trigger for reviewing the remaining uncertainty.

finding-provisional.text: Your preliminary finding has a bounded evidence basis and leaves important questions open. A named owner, review window and next source make that uncertainty actionable. Further review is still needed.

finding-unsupported.text: The cited observations do not establish the selected finding. Revisit the missing evidence question, test another explanation and keep the claim within what the delivered sources can support.

outcome-occurred.text: In the separately revealed simulation, the bounded out-of-scope objective completed. That operational result does not change the quality of reasoning from the evidence available when you submitted.

outcome-not-occurred.text: In the separately revealed simulation, the bounded out-of-scope objective did not complete. This does not establish that the whole environment is clear. Operational outcome and investigation quality remain separate.
